text: Based on the evidence from NASA FIRMS Active fire / thermal anomaly detections using VIIRS (S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21) and MODIS sensors, there were no fire detections intersecting the asset during the period from October 6, 2026, to November 5, 2026. The sensors covered the entire asset area throughout this period, ensuring comprehensive monitoring. Therefore, we can certify that no fire occurred on this asset during the specified period.
